headline: Zenith Bank 9-Month Pre-Tax Profit Rises to N928.8B on Lower Impairments
summary: Zenith Bank Group reported a pre-tax profit of N928.80 billion for the nine months ended September 2026, up 1.24% from N917.41 billion in 2025, supported by a 70.5% drop in impairment charges.
why: Zenith Bank is one of Nigeria's leading financial institutions; tracking its earnings and credit loss provisions offers key insight into the health of the West African banking sector and corporate lending risks.

impacts.name: Zenith Bank Group
impacts.why: Higher pre-tax profits and lower impairment charges indicate stronger operational profitability and better asset quality.
